checksum.description: P59 uses additive checksum with correction word(s) near end of cal region. Similar to P01 but different locations.
checksum.routine: Port from P01 checksum.rs with adjusted offsets
checksum.notes: Verify with known-good bin before write. Correction often at 0x7FFC in cal blocks.

maps_and_xdf.description: Spark, fuel, VE, timing, trans, torque management tables for P59

notes: P59 is evolution of P01 for trucks/SUVs. Very similar VPW protocol and security. Checksum locations differ slightly — use dedicated routine. Good candidate for next full integration after P01.
